notes: SHIP v1.14.363 - FIX: MASTER FILE had NO EXIT under redesign. Found by the owner on device during the .355-.362 pass. CAUSE (owner's diagnosis, confirmed against live code): rd_openMasterFile() calls showPage('master') raw; #pg-master is a LEGACY page with no per-page back header, and Rule A (v1.14.122) hides the legacy header chevron #nav-back-btn under body.rd. Net effect: the surface the BUILD MASTER FILE banner row opens had ZERO back affordance. Rule A mandates one back control per surface; this one had none, so the only way out was the bottom nav. FIX: a #master-back header as the FIRST child of #pg-master, mirroring #ref-back exactly - same .rf-back-btn chevron markup, same .rf-back-title - plus two CSS rules in the same shape as #ref-back's: base '#master-back{display:none}' as the legacy guarantee, and 'body.rd #master-back{display:flex;...}' as the ONLY gate that reveals it. ?legacy=1 reaches pg-master through its own nav with #nav-back-btn visible and stays byte-identical. ONE CORRECTION TO THE SPEC, AND IT MATTERS: the ruling specified onclick="showMode('build')". THERE IS NO 'build' KEY. showMode's map is { command:'cmd', work:'work', ref:'ref' } and the function's third line is 'if (!pid) return' - so showMode('build') is a SILENT NO-OP and would have shipped a back button that does NOTHING. That is strictly worse than the bug being fixed: it replaces 'no exit' with 'an exit that lies', and it is precisely the No-Silent-Failures violation this ship exists to remove. SHIPPED AS showMode('work'). 'work' is the mode key for the page the nav LABELS 'BUILD' - the label and the internal key diverge, which is exactly why the spec's guess was reasonable and wrong. Verified in live code that showMode('work') does the right thing on both counts: line 18481 calls showPage('work'), which activates #pg-work and deactivates #pg-master, and line 18500 adds .wk-grid, which is the class that lands the page on the BUILD banner-row grid rather than a drilled-in panel. So the back button lands exactly where the ruling asked - the BUILD banner rows - it just gets there through the key that exists. SECOND, SMALLER DEVIATION, REPORTED: the ruling said 'no new styles beyond the two #master-back rules'. Shipped with #master-back added to the EXISTING '#ref-back .rf-back-title' selector - a selector extension, not a new declaration, and #ref-back's rendering is unchanged. Reason: .rf-back-title carries NO unscoped styling anywhere in the file; its only rule is scoped to #ref-back. Reusing the class alone would have rendered the MASTER FILE title in the default face at default size, which is not 'mirror #ref-back exactly'. This is observable today on #work-back, whose title uses the same class and IS unstyled for exactly this reason - a pre-existing inconsistency this ship does not inherit. BACK TARGET IS A GRID-BACK, NOT HISTORY: showMode('work') per the ruling, not history.back() or nav_back(). Same contract #work-back and #ref-back already carry - a known parent, not wherever the user happened to come from. SCOPE: one markup block, two CSS rules, one selector extension, three stamps. No JS changed - rd_openMasterFile is untouched, because the missing affordance was markup, not routing. Nothing from .359-.362 touched. GATES: three-stamp lockstep; inline JS compiles (4 of 4 blocks) plus sw.js; CSS braces balanced in all 12 style blocks; the .359 acceptance checks re-run green (5 banner rows, 9 wall cells); all five banner rasters still referenced under their .362 names, on disk and precached. DEVICE-VERIFY: (1) badge reads v1.14.363. (2) rd: BUILD -> tap the MASTER FILE row -> a back chevron is visible top-left with 'MASTER FILE' beside it -> tap it -> lands on the BUILD banner rows. (3) The chevron looks and presses like the one on Tools/Build drill-ins (same 34px chip, cyan on press, 56px gloved hit area). (4) ?legacy=1: pg-master is unchanged, NO back chevron above the File/Profile pills, and the legacy header chevron still works as before. (5) The rest of the .355-.362 pass is unaffected - this ship touches one legacy page's first child and two CSS rules. ROLLBACK: revert this commit; MASTER FILE returns to having no exit under redesign.
